page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the memory-optimized ecs.r8ae instance family. It is provisioned on the KVM hypervisor with two dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core with simultaneous multithreading. Compute power is provided by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache, alongside support for instruction extensions such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, AES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware allocations provide 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio typical of memory-optimized cloud instances. The instance has no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded CPU capabilities due to the AMD EPYC 9T34 architecture, achieving top-tier status in stress-ng single-core tests and strong results in Geekbench single-core benchmarks. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput sits in lower percentiles across stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, reflecting the physical limitation of a single physical execution core. Memory bandwidth remains in the middle tier, reaching 45.05 GB/sec for uncached read blocks and 26.33 GB/sec for uncached write blocks. In-memory data store performance tests recorded 2.8 million Redis SET operations per second, while static web serving throughput reached 2.85 GB/sec.

The ecs.r8ae.large instance provides a cost-efficient deployment profile for workloads needing high memory capacity per thread without the expense of larger multi-core instances. It is best suited for small in-memory caching tiers, lightweight Redis deployments, microservices with modest CPU requirements but elevated RAM footprints, and background processing tasks dependent on high single-core frequency.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring two dedicated vCPUs mapped to one physical core on an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM, the configuration includes 16.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a high 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes 32 MB of L3 cache and supports modern vector instruction sets including AVX-512. It does not include bundled local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, operating with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations reflect strong single-core CPU execution, contrasted with modest multi-threaded throughput and average large-block memory transfer speeds. This hardware layout offers resource efficiency for memory-heavy, low-concurrency tasks such as small Redis caches, lightweight in-memory databases, and memory-constrained microservices.
